deskSendToQrPayment: A QR Payment code. Scan it with BT Wallet on a phone.

@deskSendToQrPayment.description: Error under To on desktop Send when the pasted text is a part of an animated QR Payment code (ur:epic-slate/…), which only the phone app (BT Wallet on a phone) reads. 'QR Payment' is the method's name.
